parsed.note_claim: Three Chinese nationals were arrested in Georgia in October 2025 for attempting to buy 2kg of uranium.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Three Chinese citizens have been arrested in Georgia's capital, Tbilisi, while allegedly trying to buy 2kg (4.4lb) of uranium, the State Security Service says.
parsed.reason: The article explicitly confirms the nationality, location, date, and amount of uranium involved in the arrest.
